def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # normalize island labels (strip extra spaces)
    if 'island' in df.columns:
        df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # clean numeric columns stored as text (commas, strings)
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
        # fix obvious unit/extra-zero error: 3625000 -> 3625 (divide by 1000 if still out of range)
        mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
        df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    if 'flipper_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # keep only allowed islands and drop missing group keys
    allowed = ['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen']
    if 'island' in df.columns:
        df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
        df = df[df['island'].notna() & (df['island'] != '') & (df['island'] != 'nan')]
        df = df[df['island'].isin(allowed)]
    counts = df.groupby('island').size()
    # drop missing group keys and return as dict
    result = {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items() if pd.notna(k)}
    return result
